vectors.description: draft-mzanaty-moq-loc-05 2.3 declares an even type's value as Length bytes, but its [MoQTransport], draft-ietf-moq-transport-10 9.1.1.2, frames an even type's value as one varint. Video Frame Marking (2.3.2.2) declares 1-3 bytes of [Framemarking]; the varint 224 cannot be that, so the value is left uninterpreted.
